title: Pharmacological investigation of a selected triazole derivative against acetic acid-induced ulcerative colitis in mouse model.
authors: Qadir, Abdul; Khan, Shahid; Nadeem, Humaira; Ahmad, Nadeem; Ul-Haq, Zaheer; Bashir, Kashif; Khan, Kashif Maqbool; Iftikhar, Muhammad Sami; Qayyum, Muhammad Imran; Latif, Muhammad; Irshad, Nadeem
one_liner_zh: 该研究评估三唑衍生物对小鼠溃疡性结肠炎的药理作用，虽含分子对接和MD模拟，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: In this study, the pharmacological and mechanistic potential of a selected synthetic triazole derivative, 4-(4-Fluorophenyl)-3-(p-tolyl)-1H-1,2,4-triazole-5(4H)-thione (TriQ), was evaluated in an acetic acid-induced ulcerative colitis (UC) mice model using an integrated approach involving molecular docking, molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, biochemical assays, gene expression analysis, and histopathological evaluation. TriQ was selected based on the pharmacological relevance of triazole scaffolds, particularly those containing fluorophenyl and aryl substitutions, which are associated with enhanced anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties and improved target-binding interactions. In silico analysis revealed strong binding affinities of TriQ toward key inflammatory mediators, including Nuclear Factor kappa B (NF-kappaB), Interleukin-6 (IL-6), and Tumor Necrosis Factor-alpha (TNF-alpha), stabilized through hydrogen bonding and hydrophobic interactions. MD simulations confirmed the structural stability and consistent conformational behavior of the TriQ-protein complexes over a 100 ns trajectory. In vivo administration of TriQ (5, 10, and 20 mg/kg) significantly alleviated acetic acid-induced colitis, with the highest efficacy observed at 20 mg/kg. Treatment markedly improved disease activity index and restored altered hematological and biochemical parameters, along with normalization of hepatic and renal function markers. TriQ also enhanced endogenous antioxidant defenses, including catalase (CAT), glutathione S-transferase (GST), and reduced glutathione (GSH), while suppressing oxidative stress and inflammatory mediators such as myeloperoxidase (MPO) and nitric oxide (NO). At the molecular level, TriQ significantly downregulated pro-inflammatory cytokines (IL-1beta, IL-6, IL-8, and TNF-alpha) and upregulated heme oxygenase-1 (HO-1) expression, as confirmed by ELISA and qRT-PCR analyses. Histopathological findings demonstrated marked preservation of colonic architecture, and reduced epithelial injury. Collectively, these findings demonstrate that TriQ exerts potent anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects primarily through modulation of the NF-kappaB/HO-1 signaling axis, highlighting its potential as a promising lead candidate for the development of novel anti-ulcerative colitis therapeutics.
abstract_zh: 本研究采用分子对接、分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟、生化检测、基因表达分析及组织病理学评估的综合方法，在乙酸诱导的溃疡性结肠炎（ulcerative colitis, UC）小鼠模型中，评估了一种选定合成三唑衍生物4-(4-氟苯基)-3-(对甲苯基)-1H-1,2,4-三唑-5(4H)-硫酮（TriQ）的药理学及机制潜力。TriQ的筛选基于三唑骨架的药理学相关性，特别是含有氟苯基和芳基取代的化合物，这些结构特征与增强的抗炎和抗氧化特性及改善的靶标结合相互作用相关。计算机模拟分析显示，TriQ对关键炎症介质，包括核因子κB（NF-kappaB）、白细胞介素-6（IL-6）和肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-alpha），具有强结合亲和力，并通过氢键和疏水相互作用稳定。MD模拟在100 ns轨迹内确认了TriQ-蛋白质复合物的结构稳定性和一致的构象行为。TriQ的体内给药（5、10和20 mg/kg）显著缓解了乙酸诱导的结肠炎，其中20 mg/kg剂量下观察到最高疗效。治疗显著改善了疾病活动指数，并恢复了改变的血液学和生化参数，同时使肝肾功能标志物正常化。TriQ还增强了内源性抗氧化防御系统，包括过氧化氢酶（CAT）、谷胱甘肽S-转移酶（GST）和还原型谷胱甘肽（GSH），同时抑制了氧化应激和炎症介质，如髓过氧化物酶（MPO）和一氧化氮（NO）。在分子水平上，TriQ显著下调了促炎细胞因子（IL-1beta、IL-6、IL-8和TNF-alpha），并上调了血红素加氧酶-1（HO-1）的表达，这通过ELISA和qRT-PCR分析得到证实。组织病理学结果显示，结肠结构得到显著保留，上皮损伤减少。综合来看，这些发现表明TriQ主要通过调节NF-kappaB/HO-1信号轴发挥强效抗炎和抗氧化作用，突显其作为开发新型抗溃疡性结肠炎治疗药物的有前景的先导候选物的潜力。
